blocks.text: Why load board data entry slows you down

The core of your work is moving freight, not typing zip codes. When you manually post a load to four or twelve different boards, you are acting as a human relay. This process is repetitive and prone to error. You likely experience fatigue after the third load of the morning. That fatigue leads to transposition errors. A wrong weight or a missed zip code digit causes issues that ripple through your entire supply chain.
The hidden costs of manual data entry

You might think manual entry is just part of the job. It is actually a massive financial drain. Beyond the $28,500 annual cost per employee, consider the opportunity cost. Every minute you spend on a load board is a minute you are not calling a carrier or negotiating a rate. When you make a mistake, the cost to fix it is often 8 to 12 times the time of the original entry. You have to find the error, contact the carrier, update the TMS, and notify the customer.
Automating freight broker load posting without expensive software

You do not need a million dollar custom integration to start. Many modern TMS platforms offer built-in multi-posting features. Check your current provider settings. Look for a setting that says Post to Load Boards. If your TMS does not support this, you can use browser automation. You can create saved snippets for common load details. Use a text expansion tool to fill out forms in your browser with a few keystrokes.

Before you automate, audit your current process. Map out every field you type manually. If you find yourself typing the same information across three different tabs, that is your primary target for automation.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to click buttons on a load board?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons for you. It can guide you through the process, point at where you should click, or help you dictate information into text fields.

faq.question: Is it safe to use automation tools with my TMS?
faq.answer: Always check your TMS provider's terms of service. Ensure your automation tool respects your data privacy and does not violate any employer policies regarding client information.

faq.question: How do I start automating on a Mac?
faq.answer: Start by identifying the repetitive fields in your browser. Use built-in macOS features like Text Replacement in System Settings > Keyboard > Text Replacements to speed up your typing.
